description: Structured intake of a prospect into an SMB's funnel with validation and deduplication on (smb_id, phone or email). Stores the prospect in the SMB's AgentBroker lead funnel — this is AgentBroker's own lead store, NOT a write into the business's own CRM. [$0.05/per_call] [async→get_outcome]

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: a 24h replay returns the original receipt, not re-run or charged.

consent_record_id.description: Optional ID of a consent record proving the prospect asked to be contacted (e.g., they filled an SMB's intake form or requested a quote). Required when downstream send_message calls are anticipated.

name: capture_lead
